Move the beforeSession call inside the try block so a throw from it
reaches the same catch and finally as any other failure in the turn:
onError fires with its usual argument shape and afterSession runs, so
a resource allocated in beforeSession and released in afterSession no
longer leaks on the path where the allocation failed. The rejection
still reaches the caller unchanged. The spec records the decision
that afterSession gets no signal the turn never started, and the
CHANGELOG says what changes for an existing consumer.

Closes #94
